checks.message: Canonical mission lock must target real capability realization.
Predicates must be subordinate evidence, not the mission.
Benchmarks must be subordinate diagnostics, not the mission.
Internal Astra-themed suite completion must not be represented as external Astra parity.
P_real must equal the number of active identities explicitly counted as real.
Component evidence from different executors cannot be composed into one real worker.
Val Town must remain noncanonical/forbidden unless explicitly superseded by a newer authority decision.
Current allowed frontier actions must not route through forbidden providers.

allowed_actions: reconstruct current shared ASTRA_RUNTIME from valid existing capability components
select the smallest orthogonal real mission portfolio maximizing capability and interaction exposure per wall clock time
run portfolio missions concurrently against the same runtime
freeze exact observed blockers and attack only those blockers with maximum useful parallelism
race reuse composition adaptation and invention only beneath a real blocker
integrate independently verified winning repairs globally into the shared runtime
replay failed actions and resume missions immediately
expand legitimate zero cost execution capacity only as a parallel multiplier
defer formal qualification until the operational portfolio closes
